name: screen-011-difficulty
note: 011 screen (no probes): candidate effects for difficulty levels 1 and 3. Each variant pairs a level-1 candidate with a level-3 candidate; level 1's effect reads as d1 - d0, level 3's as d3 - d2. Greedy only (the top agent at r3). Ran before extra_threats became 'in all, countries in turn': xt1 here dealt one extra threat per country (2 a round); the baseline then had r3's level 1 and 3, so variant 'old' is r3.
